name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=palette, descriptor=overbright_settle_step_loop. Accurately captures the additive over-bright (saturate-to-white) effect that settles/decays down to the base palette by stepping intensity in a loop. No Ghidra address residue (suffix '_step_loop' is descriptive, not the function/data hex address).
purpose: Additive over-bright palette pulse: walk intensity from start_intensity down to 0 inclusive, re-applying the full DAC range each step (with a per-step delay), so the screen white-flashes then settles back to the base palette.
logic_summary: for (intensity = (int)start_intensity; intensity >= 0; intensity--) { fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add(0, 0xFF, intensity); fd2_delay_ms(step_delay_ms); }. Each iteration writes min(base_palette[i]+intensity, 0x3F) across the entire 256-entry DAC range, then sleeps step_delay_ms. Loop runs start_intensity+1 times (the int-cast loop var stops after the intensity==0 step writes the base palette unchanged). intensity>=0x3F saturates every channel to full white; intensity==0 restores the normal scene palette -- so it is NOT a fade-to-black, it settles to base.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Starting additive over-bright intensity; loop counts down from this value to 0 inclusive. Sole caller (fd2_chapter_27_end) always passes 0x50 (80). Used directly as the 'add' amount fed to fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add.
params.reason: Live Ghidra param name is the generic placeholder param_1 (flagged needs_rename); src already declares it as start_intensity. Rename to start_intensity to reflect its role as the initial additive intensity. Apply in Stage 2.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Milliseconds passed to fd2_delay_ms (CRT delay() wrapper) once per step, controlling pulse-down speed. Caller passes 5/4/3/2 across successive invocations.
params.reason: Live Ghidra param name is the generic placeholder param_2 (flagged needs_rename); src already declares it as step_delay_ms. Rename to step_delay_ms to reflect the per-step delay in milliseconds. Apply in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is the VGA DAC palette being rewritten across the pulse and left at the base palette on completion.
